senses.gloss:
m. (-न्धः)
1 Continuous application or action, continuance, uninterruptedness.
2 A connected discussion, or narrative.
E.
प्र before बधि to bind, aff. अच्.

f. (-ना)
A feigned story, a work of imagination, whether founded on fact or not.
E.
प्रबन्ध a connected narrative, and कल्पना a making.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Strong, powerful.
m. (-लः)
A sprout, a shoot.
E.
प्र before बल to be strong, aff. अच्.

mn. (-लः-लं)
1 Coral.
2 A shoot, a sprout, a new leaf.
3 The neck of a lute.
m. (-लः)
1 An animal.
2 A pupil.
E.
प्र before बल to be strong, and aff. घञ्; also प्रबालक.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Paining, afflicting, tormenting.
E.
प्र before बाध to pain, शानच् aff.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Having new leaves or shoots.
E.
प्रबाल, and मतुप् aff.

mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं)
1 Wise, learned.
2 Blown, expanded.
3 Wakened, awake, roused.
E.
प्र before बुद्ध to be wise, aff. क्त, form irr.

m. (-धः)
1 Vigilance, wakefulness, active or vigilant state of being.
2 Intellect, understanding.
3 Knowledge, wisdom.
4 Sense, consciousness.
5 Awaking either from ignorance or sleep.
E.
प्र before बुध to understand, aff. घञ्.

n. (-नं)
1 Awakening, arousing, exciting, reviving.
2 Instructing.
3 Reviving the fragrance of a perfume, which had lost its scent.
f. (-नी)
The lunation on which VIṢṆU is supposed to wake from his sleep, the eleventh of the light half of Kartik; also प्रबोधिनी.
E.
प्र before बुध to know or understand, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Aroused, awakened.
2 Instructed.
E.
प्र before बुध to know, causal v., क्त aff.

f. (-ता)
A species of the Atijagatī metre.

n. (-ल्यं)
1 Power, vigour.
2 Predominance.
E.
प्रबल strong, ष्यञ् aff.

m. (-कः)
Dawn, daybreak.
E.
प्रबोध waking, and ठक् aff.
